Run `pnpm census` after changing a tool, skill, prompt, command, persona or env var.

# CLI reference

`rule-mcp` (binary: `bin/rule-mcp.js`). Invoked with no command it
starts the STDIO MCP server (agents spawn it bare).

Global flags: `-h, --help` (usage) and `-v, --version` (package version).
Errors exit 1 and print to stderr; `--help` exits 0.

## help

Show the full usage guide

```
rule-mcp help
```

---

## serve

Start the MCP server (STDIO by default)

```
rule-mcp serve
```

### Options

| Flag                 | Description                                                | Default | Choices |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------- |
| `--transport <type>` | stdio (default), http (Streamable HTTP), or sse (HTTP+SSE) | -       | -       |
| `--port <number>`    | port for http/sse transport                                | -       | -       |
| `--ssl-cert <path>`  | TLS certificate (requires --ssl-key)                       | -       | -       |
| `--ssl-key <path>`   | TLS private key (auto-generates self-signed if missing)    | -       | -       |

---

## up

Same as "serve --transport sse" (on-demand HTTP daemon)

```
rule-mcp up
```

### Options

| Flag              | Description             | Default | Choices |
| ----------------- | ----------------------- | ------- | ------- |
| `--port <number>` | port for the SSE server | -       | -       |

## install

Install rule-mcp into an agent/IDE (edits mcp.json)

```
rule-mcp install
```

### Options

| Flag             | Description                                        | Default | Choices |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------- |
| `--agent <name>` | target agent, or 'all' for every supported agent   | all     | -       |
| `--mode <name>`  | stdio (default), daemon (SSE), or docker           | -       | -       |
| `--global`       | use clean command path (requires global install)   | -       | -       |
| `--force`        | override existing configuration                    | -       | -       |
| `--dry-run`      | preview without writing                            | -       | -       |
| `--json`         | print machine-readable JSON instead of Terminal UI | -       | -       |

---

## config

Print the mcp.json snippet, or manage RULE_MCP_* env vars with `config env`

```
rule-mcp config section
```

### Arguments

| Argument  | Description                                                        | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `section` | env to configure RULE_MCP_* variables (default: print mcp.json snippet) | -       |

### Options

| Flag            | Description                                      | Default | Choices |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- | ------- |
| `--global`      | use clean command path (requires global install) | -       | -       |
| `--mode <name>` | stdio (default), daemon (SSE), or docker         | -       | -       |
| `--set <pair>`  | KEY=VALUE to save (repeatable)                   |         | -       |
| `--list`        | list saved RULE_MCP_* env vars                        | -       | -       |
| `--unset <key>` | remove a saved RULE_MCP_* env var                     | -       | -       |

## adr

Create a new Architecture Decision Record (ADR)

```
rule-mcp adr action title
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description | Default |
| -------- | ----------- | ------- |
| `action` | new         | -       |
| `title`  | -           | -       |

### Options

| Flag                    | Description                                  | Default            | Choices    |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | ---------- |
| `--status <s>`          | proposed                                     | accepted (default) | deprecated | superseded | -   | -   |
| `--context <text>`      | context forcing factors                      | -                  | -          |
| `--decision <text>`     | decision made and why                        | -                  | -          |
| `--consequences <text>` | positive and negative consequences           | -                  | -          |
| `--tags <list>`         | comma-separated tags (default: architecture) | -                  | -          |

## handoff

Generate a compressed LLM context handoff summary

```
rule-mcp handoff subcommand
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Description                    | Default |
| ------------ | ------------------------------ | ------- |
| `subcommand` | doctor to repair ADR numbering | -       |

### Options

| Flag            | Description                                          | Default | Choices |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------- |
| `--dir <path>`  | project root (default: .)                            | .       | -       |
| `--format <f>`  | full (default), brief, minimal                       | -       | -       |
| `--compress`    | aggressively truncate values                         | -       | -       |
| `--mode <m>`    | handoff (default) or close-session                   | -       | -       |
| `--fix`         | apply the ADR renumber plan                          | -       | -       |
| `--fix-commits` | amend local commit messages to match renumbered ADRs | -       | -       |
